sloka: एवमुक्ता हनुमता वैदेही जनकात्मजा ।अब्रवीद्द्रष्टुमिच्छामि भर्तारं वानरोत्तम ।। ६.११६.४९ ।।
transliteration: evamuktā hanumatā vaidehī janakātmajā ।abravīddraṣṭumicchāmi bhartāraṁ vānarottama ।। 6.116.49 ।।

translations.english: Sita, having spoken that way to Hanuman, he, who was capable of good expression, replied as follows to Rama's consort, who was irreproachable.
